chars.OBEID: OBEID: a young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.MUSTAPHA: MUSTAPHA: a young Moroccan man wearing a red-and-white striped short-sleeve shirt, beige shorts and brown sandals, sunglasses pushed on top of his head.
chars.SAM: SAM: a tall broad American tourist man wearing a light-blue sleeveless tank top, khaki cargo shorts and hiking sandals, a bead necklace.
chars.EMMA: EMMA: a young American tourist woman wearing a bright green summer dress and a wide straw hat.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night inside an old riad guesthouse in Essaouira with white walls, blue wooden doors and hanging lanterns. SAM stands at the foot of a tiled staircase, furious, pointing up the stairs and shouting; OBEID stands next to him, shocked, hands raised, looking up the stairs too.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MUSTAPHA runs up a narrow tiled riad staircase two steps at a time, in a hurry, nervous face, lantern light on blue walls, night.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: OBEID climbs the same riad staircase behind, worried, biting his lip, holding the white wall, looking up nervously, night lantern light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On the riad staircase landing, OBEID grabs MUSTAPHA by the arm to stop him, MUSTAPHA tries to pull free, both tense, night.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Rooftop terrace of the riad at night with cushions and lanterns, Essaouira rooftops and the dark sea behind. MUSTAPHA and EMMA sit close together on a cushion, startled and embarrassed, while SAM appears at the rooftop door with his mouth wide open in shock.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On the riad rooftop terrace at night, SAM explodes in anger, shouting with both arms waving, face to face with MUSTAPHA who leans back with an awkward guilty smile.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: On the riad rooftop at night, OBEID covers his mouth with both hands trying not to laugh, eyes squeezed, shoulders shaking, in the background an angry silhouette of a man shouting.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On the riad rooftop at night, SAM and EMMA both shout and point at OBEID and MUSTAPHA, who stand side by side with hands raised defensively, chaotic angry argument.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the riad courtyard at night, SAM holds a smartphone up to his ear and walks angrily toward the big blue front door, while OBEID runs after him with pleading hands, begging him to stop.
